name: Hilo
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Hilo, HI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Hilo, Kona and Hawaii Island for 2026: Hilo Christmas Parade, Grinch musical, Kona tree lighting and Kailua Village parade.
lede: Hawaii Island celebrates Christmas with the East Hawaii Lions' Hilo Christmas Parade, a Grinch musical at UH Hilo, and tree lighting and parade traditions in Kailua-Kona. This page covers Hilo, Kona and the rest of Hawaii Island.
celebrates: On Hawaii Island, the season opens in Hilo with the Hilo Christmas Parade on the Saturday after Thanksgiving, hosted by four East Hawaii Lions clubs, and the University of Hawaii at Hilo's Performing Arts Center stages the Grinch musical that same weekend. On the Kona side, Island Breeze Productions holds a free tree lighting at King Kamehameha Kona Beach Resort on Kamakahonu Bay, where Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by canoe, and the Kailua-Kona Community Parade Association runs the Kailua Village Christmas Parade a week later.
lastyear: The Kona Beach Resort tree lighting has been held for several years: the host calls the 2026 ceremony its 4th annual, which means the first was held in 2023. The Hilo Christmas Parade page links to a video of an earlier parade, and the Parades in Kona site shows photos from past Kailua Village Christmas Parades, so both parades are long running community traditions.
facts: The East Hawaii Lions Clubs that host the Hilo Christmas Parade are the Akaka Falls Lions, Hilo Lions, Hilo Crescent City Lions and Hilo Waiakea Lions. The Kona Beach Resort ceremony sits on Kamakahonu Bay, and Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive there by canoe. The UH Hilo Grinch musical uses a book and lyrics by Timothy Mason and music by Mel Marvin.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train on Hawaii Island for 2026. Hawaii Island's rail history lives in museums such as the Laupahoehoe Train Museum on the Hamakua Coast, which our Ocean View page links to. Check the museum's own site for hours before you drive out, and note that this page's Christmas events are parades, a tree lighting and a stage show.
train_links: A train museum on the Hamakua Coast of Hawaii Island.
traditions: The East Hawaii Lions Clubs' parade on the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
The university's Performing Arts Center holiday show.
Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by canoe, followed by carols and a candle lighting.
A Kona evening parade with a new theme each year.
kidfact: At the Kona tree lighting, Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by outrigger canoe instead of a sleigh.
faq: How does Hawaii Island celebrate Christmas?
Hilo and Kona each hold a community parade, and Kona adds a free tree lighting at King Kamehameha Kona Beach Resort where Santa arrives by canoe. UH Hilo also stages the Grinch musical.
Does this page cover Kona as well as Hilo?
Yes. It covers Hilo, Kailua-Kona and the rest of Hawaii Island.
Yes. Public parades are free to watch, and the Kona tree lighting is free with an RSVP requested.
Where can kids meet Santa on Hawaii Island?
At the King Kamehameha Kona Beach Resort tree lighting on December 4, where Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by canoe and families can take photos.
Is there a Christmas train on Hawaii Island?
We did not find one for 2026. The Laupahoehoe Train Museum is a rail history stop on the Hamakua Coast.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Hilo, Kona and the rest of Hawaii Island for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 3 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Hilo Christmas Parade) through December 12 (Kailua Village Christmas Parade), with the Grinch musical at UH Hilo (November 28 and 29) and the Christmas Tree Lighting at King Kamehameha Kona Beach Resort (December 4) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found on Hawaii Island

  • 4 Christmas events for kids on Hawaii Island, in Hilo and Kailua-Kona
  • 3 free events: the Hilo Christmas Parade, the tree lighting at King Kamehameha Kona Beach Resort and the Kailua Village Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Santa and Mrs. Claus arrive by canoe at the Kona Beach Resort tree lighting (December 4)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Hilo Christmas Parade (November 28), Kona Beach Resort tree lighting (December 4) and Kailua Village Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Shows: Dr. Seuss's How the Grinch Stole Christmas The Musical at UH Hilo Performing Arts Center (November 28 and 29)
  • Season: November 28 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Hawaii Island families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Honolulu, which covers Honolulu City Lights, The Nutcracker at Blaisdell, How the Grinch Stole Christmas at Diamond Head Theatre and weekly Santa photos at Royal Hawaiian Center.
